phase_prompt.summary: The Judge in its standard, observing state within the void.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A low-angle, cinematic medium shot of The Judge, a colossal biomechanical entity seated on a dark basalt throne. The figure is robed in heavy, oxidized metallic garments with gold circuitry embroidery. The face is a smooth, windowless obsidian visor reflecting a harsh red environment. The atmosphere is thick with dust and static. Intricate details, photorealistic textures, grounded sci-fi, dramatic shadows.
